Title: Finalize Linear and GitHub course workflow
Description: Objective: create the required 298B Linear project, statuses, labels, GitHub integration, branch protection, and contribution workflow documentation. Acceptance criteria: TA invited as Admin; statuses configured; labels configured; GitHub repo connected; default branch protected; workflow doc committed.

Title: Expand macro ingestion and validation
Description: Objective: populate the expanded FRED macro feature set used by the macro agent. Acceptance criteria: 10Y-2Y spread, VIX, and WTI oil are ingested; silver macro contains the expanded columns; missing values are reported; macro agent no longer relies on null expanded fields.

Title: Train baseline ML risk classifier
Description: Objective: add a supervised baseline model that predicts risk label or risk score from Gold features. Acceptance criteria: train/validation/test metrics are reported; model artifact is saved; inference script exists; comparison against rule baseline is documented.

Title: Wire FinBERT sentiment inference
Description: Objective: replace or augment VADER sentiment with FinBERT-based financial sentiment inference. Acceptance criteria: inference script reads news headlines; outputs sentiment label/confidence; sentiment agent consumes the output; fallback behavior remains available.

Title: Add hybrid critic scoring
Description: Objective: combine rule baseline, ML model output, and specialist agent evidence in the critic layer. Acceptance criteria: final verdict includes rule score, ML score, critic score, confidence, and explanation; no generated numeric claims lack source fields.

Title: Improve LangGraph debate revision loop
Description: Objective: strengthen contradiction handling in the debate state machine. Acceptance criteria: label and score dispersion contradictions are detected; revision rounds are captured; high-severity contradictions trigger human review; debate verdict is preferred by the API when available.

Title: Build API-backed stock risk app
Description: Objective: expose project artifacts through FastAPI and drive the frontend from API calls. Acceptance criteria: companies, prices, verdicts, monitoring, and artifact endpoints work; frontend can generate critic and debate verdicts; API health endpoint reports data readiness.

Title: Improve investment Q&A frontend
Description: Objective: make the frontend answer whether a company is suitable for research or requires review. Acceptance criteria: answer uses final verdict, confidence, human-review flag, contradictions, drivers, and offsets; missing verdicts trigger generation; UI avoids broken JSON/PDF links.

Title: Add frontend loading and error states
Description: Objective: make the dashboard robust when API requests fail or verdict generation is running. Acceptance criteria: loading state appears during generation; API errors are shown clearly; user can retry; layout remains stable on mobile and desktop.

Title: Create evaluation and monitoring report
Description: Objective: document model quality, agent disagreements, confidence behavior, and pipeline health. Acceptance criteria: report includes dataset split, label balance, baseline metrics, example verdicts, monitoring records, and limitations.

Title: Add reproducibility guide
Description: Objective: document setup and exact commands for data pipeline, verdict generation, API server, frontend, and evaluation. Acceptance criteria: README or docs include virtual environment setup, env vars, commands, expected outputs, and troubleshooting.

Title: Add automated validation checks
Description: Objective: add repeatable checks for Python syntax, frontend JS syntax, and core API endpoint health. Acceptance criteria: scripts or Makefile commands exist; README lists them; checks pass locally.

Title: Prepare final demo evidence package
Description: Objective: collect screenshots, PDFs, JSON verdicts, model metrics, and PR/Linear links for final review. Acceptance criteria: demo folder or document lists artifacts; evidence ties to Linear issues and PRs; app screenshots show at least three company verdict examples.
